llm._comment: Tried in this order; first provider with an API key set (as a GitHub secret / env var) that succeeds wins. Groq/OpenRouter free tiers cap tokens-per-minute below what the (large) selection prompt needs, so they're expected to fail over fast on that call via 429 - they still cover the small summary call and any Gemini outage.
